title: More middle than high school students in Korea experience feelings of depression: data
caption:
Recent data from the Korean Educational Development Institute shows a concerning trend: middle schoolers are reporting higher levels of severe sadness than high school students for the third year in a row. If you or someone you know is struggling, help is available by dialing 109.

Source: Koreaherald - More middle than high school students in Korea experience feelings of depression: data

https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10914019
